database: Fresh disposable PostgreSQL container using --network none; existing local databases untouched
checks: Injected pre-commit failure rolled back pacing table, grants and all changed functions.
Existing public table definitions and privileges unchanged.
One shared workspace admission across channel history, thread replies and different companies/connections; another workspace can run.
Waiting jobs retain attempt/error counts and stay queued.
History and thread Retry-After outcomes update shared cooldown; exact settlement replay does not extend it.
Saved-page settlement bypasses provider pacing and exhausted provider attempts without releasing a newer reservation.
Pacing update failure rolls back job settlement.
Concurrent first gate insert cannot admit two jobs; another workspace progresses while the first transaction is held.
Rolled-back claims consume no budget; expired unpublished jobs wait through the reservation before a new fenced claim.
Stale finish and repeatable-read claim refused.
Existing synthetic email, Slack message, source-version and interaction rows byte-equivalent as JSON before/after.
Anonymous/authenticated roles have no pacing-table access; service cannot delete/truncate it.
limitations: Local migration only; no hosted release, provider request, credentials, schedules or production change. TEST remains release 012/runtime v4.

Conservative single history-worker job per workspace with 60-second spacing after settlement; shared across apps until verified app identity/rate tier exists. This does not govern unrelated Slack integrations.
Finite 100-candidate scan and five-job maximum claim batch; polling/scheduling remains separate.
Durable cooldown begins when the worker records its failure; a process lost before recording a provider response cannot preserve an unseen Retry-After header.
Continuous/multi-window ingestion, live provider access, operator recovery and broader LEARN V1 remain incomplete.
